items.title: Darboe Accuses Government of Plot to Incite Violence and Frame UDP Ahead of December Election
items.summary: By Seedy Jobe United Democratic Party (UDP) leader ANM Ousainu Darboe has accused President Adama Barrow’s government of plotting to provoke violence and blame it on the opposition party as a pretext for declaring a state of emergency ahead of the December 5 presidential elect...
items.author: Seedy Jobe
